$comment: Copy of the schema owned by the finish-stage skill; keep identical.
title: manifest
description: Machine-readable summary a stage writes next to its report.md. The explainer builds its step plan from `highlights`.

brief.description: The user's finish brief, verbatim: what the stage was about and which files were read.

goal.description: One or two sentences: what this stage set out to establish.

summary.description: What came out, in plain words.

source.description: File (relative to the stage dir) where the value can be found.

meaning.description: What the number tells you; include the budget/threshold it is compared against if any.

budget.description: Threshold or target the metric is judged against.

role.description: What the file contains and what it is for, e.g. 'table scenarios: per-scenario wall-clock'.

columns.description: Column/field → meaning (and unit) for tabular data.

highlights.description: The 3–6 things worth explaining, in narrative order. Each becomes one explainer step.

why.description: Why it matters for the next stage.
